title: Verified Software Engineering Trajectory Record v1
description: Minimum executable contract for the verified-software-engineering-trajectories (VSET) pilot (#155 record kinds; #154 actor envelope). This slice is schema + fixtures + oracle tests only: no bulk generation, no Hub publish, no Prometheus seeding. Training views must stay compatible with #26 (no thought / internal_reasoning*). Factory onboarding of a live VSET generator is a reviewed FACTORY-REGISTRY.json row plus payload-first kind registration — not a slug hardcoded in identity logic. pipelines/validate_vset.py is the authoritative gate and is strictly stronger than this document: the recursive hidden-reasoning ban on training_view normalizes key names across case, separators, and camelCase boundaries and matches the whole internal_reasoning* family at any nesting depth, which JSON Schema cannot express, so schema-valid is necessary but never sufficient. The conditional reviewer and per-kind payload requirements below mirror REVIEW_REQUIRED_KINDS and KIND_PAYLOAD_KEYS in pipelines/vset_constants.py; tests/test_vset_schema_drift.py asserts they stay equal.

training_view.description: Curated/training projection. Must not contain thought, internal_reasoning, or internal_reasoning_verbatim. Raw evidence belongs outside this object.

trace.description: Optional raw evidence. Hidden reasoning may remain here; it must not leak into training_view.

prometheus_lineage.description: Optional top-level Operation Prometheus lineage claim. Declared because pipelines/validate_vset.py reads it as a source_kind masquerade signal; a synthetic record carrying it is rejected with vset.source_kind_masquerade. Any JSON type, since the masquerade scan walks strings, objects, and arrays alike.

then.description: REVIEW_REQUIRED_KINDS: review_remediation_v1 needs an explicit reviewer object, never null and never absent.
